action.command: param([string]$WorkspaceRoot = 'D:\ecdsa-ocaml', [string]$SessionId = '1789462133168_k6kyu'); Set-Location $WorkspaceRoot; $buildOutput = & opam exec -- dune build lib/crypto/ 2>&1; $buildExit = $LASTEXITCODE; $buildOutput | Select-Object -First 80; Write-Host "`n=== BUILD EXIT CODE: $buildExit ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan; if ($buildExit -eq 0) { Write-Host "BUILD: PASS" -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host "BUILD: FAIL" -ForegroundColor Red }; $kiroPrompt = "You are working on the Dune/OCaml project at $WorkspaceRoot.`n`nBUILD OUTPUT:`n$buildOutput`n`nGOAL: propose the single most important command to fix the next problem. If nothing needs fixing, respond: DONE"; $kiroOut = & kiro --id $SessionId --non-interactive $kiroPrompt 2>&1 | Out-String; Write-Host "`n=== KIRO OUTPUT ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host $kiroOut; if ($kiroOut -match '(?m)^\s*DONE\s*$') { Write-Host "kiro reports nothing to fix." -ForegroundColor Green; exit 0 }; $m = [regex]::Match($kiroOut, '(?m)^\s*CMD:\s*(.+)$'); if (-not $m.Success) { Write-Host "kiro produced no CMD line." -ForegroundColor Yellow; exit 1 }; $cmd = $m.Groups[1].Value.Trim(); $allowedCommands = @('opam exec -- dune build', 'opam exec -- dune runtest', 'opam exec -- dune fmt', 'git status --short', 'git diff --stat', 'git diff', 'Get-ChildItem', 'Get-Content', 'Select-String'); $isSafe = $false; foreach ($allowed in $allowedCommands) { if ($cmd -match "^\\s*\\Q$allowed\\E") { $isSafe = $true; break } }; if (-not $isSafe) { Write-Host "Command not in allowlist. Requires manual approval." -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host "Proposed command: $cmd" -ForegroundColor Yellow; exit 1 }; Write-Host "`n=== Cline will execute (safe command) ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host $cmd -ForegroundColor Cyan; $clinePrompt = "Execute this exact PowerShell command in $WorkspaceRoot: $cmd.
